    Lemma 4.10: the support poset of a thin module #

    lem:thin-module-incidence (scalar-normalization.tex): "Let T be a finite directed category, and let M be a covariant or contravariant k-linear functor from T to vector spaces with dim M(y) ≤ 1 for every object y. Let R be the category obtained from T by passing to the quotient by the annihilator of M and discarding the objects y with M(y) = 0. Then R is the incidence category of a finite poset. If T is representation-finite, then so is R."

    For M = T(s, -) (a source, covariant) and M = T(-, t) (a sink, contravariant) in the graded covering category, the passage to R is the surjective algebra map from the category algebra of the support (Lemma 4.7) to the incidence algebra, sending a morphism to its action on M (qSrc, qSnk). Hence the incidence algebra is representation-finite (Lemma 4.6 applied to the quotient).

                  Lemma 4.12 for the graded covering category: it has a multiplicative basis.
